headline: A 1996 executive order by President Clinton dealing with how the federal government works with tribal colleges and universities.
what_it_does: This executive order concerns tribal colleges and universities, which are schools chartered by or connected to Native American tribes. No summary was provided, so details here are limited. Based on the title, it sets federal policy on how government agencies support or work with these schools.

who_it_affects.how: The order sets federal policy on how government agencies work with and support these schools.

who_it_affects.group: Students at tribal colleges and universities, many of them Native American
who_it_affects.how: Any change in federal support for their schools could affect the programs and resources available to them.
The order likely directs agencies on how they deal with tribal colleges, though the exact duties are not described in the source provided.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 19, 1996; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
